notes.title: Drone Zone Update 19.07.2024!
notes.content:
A number of major changes have been made:

1) We fundamentally changed the maps: we doubled the size of the maps, made more pronounced lines, now there are 3 clear corridors. So far there are 2 new large maps. There are spans between the lines. Distances have increased significantly - we recommend carrying a teleporter to the base with you and using specially installed teleporters (can be found on the mini map)

2) Increased the speed of drones by 2 times.

3) Added a mini-event. An Ejection occurs periodically (accompanied by sound and visual effect). You need to have time to hide in a safe zone, if you don’t have time, you take damage. After being dropped, 2 types of scrap appear on the map in special zones - yellow (items drop out) and purple (you receive enhancing effects). Scrap areas are protected by an electrical anomaly.

4) We added additional turrets to each of the lines and increased the number of creep drones flying along the lines.

5) We solved the problem with strange mistakes in sniper mode.

notes.title: Drone Zone Update 03.05.2024!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players! The Drone Zone game update has been released on 05/03/2024!

1. Added 2 new drones to the game: “Barrel” and “Porcupine”
2. Progress on drones was reset. Earned silver, gold and experience are saved.
3. The module crafting system has been reworked.
4. Game balance improved. 
5. More experience from creeps, faster leveling.
6. Menu improved, screen for selecting/unlocking dronesdrones added.

notes.title: Drone Zone update 03/29/2024!
notes.content:
Attention! Major gameplay update for Drone Zone from 03/29/2024!

1. We introduced a NEW DRONE “Ninja” into the game - quite fast and strong, with comfortable arcade shooting and active abilities, health is not very high, but has a great potential for causing damage, requires careful play, especially at the first levels.

We have started actively introducing content into the game, and we will now be adding new drones on a regular basis.

2. The balance of sniper and arcade shooting has been reworked. 
3. The health of all drones has been reduced.
4. Flight dynamics have been slightly increased.
5. The amount of experience for killing creeps has been increased.
6. The structure of the combat store has been redone.
7. Training: English voice acting has been added, and Russian voice acting has been improved.
8. Improved shooting of the "electronic" drone, reduced dispersion when shooting

notes.title: Drone Zone Update 02.02.2024!
notes.content:
1) Base destruction reworked.
2) Daily missions reworked. Improved balance and visibility.
3) Improved feedback on gaining levels and experience during battle.
4) Crafting modules system improved. Now we can better see all characteristics we got.
5) Slightly improved optimization of all processes.

Our discord channel: https://discord.gg/PZ5WVHdsH8

Your feedback is very important to us! We are waiting for everyone in the game!
